## Chrauto AI 0.4.0 — meet Chron

### Talk live with "Chron"
- **Hands-free wake word:** turn on "Hands-free Chron" and just say *"Chron, open YouTube and play lo-fi"* from any app. It also understands "Hey Chron…", and common mis-hearings like Kron/Cron.
- **Real conversations:** ask questions ("Chron, what's a good name for a cat?") and Chron answers out loud. Then it keeps listening for a few seconds, so you can reply without saying its name again.
- **Live transcript:** the floating buddy shows what it's hearing while you speak, and its replies appear as chat bubbles in the app.
- **Smart routing:** "stop" / "cancel" stops the running task right away. Commands become tasks, and questions get spoken answers, all using the AI provider you picked.
- **Mic stays quiet while Chron talks**, so it never hears itself. You get a haptic tick and a soft chime when it wakes.
- **Control it from anywhere:** a notification with Talk / Stop task / Turn off buttons, plus a "Chron" Quick Settings tile. You can also rename the wake word.
- Pauses listening when the screen is off to save battery (on by default).

### Faster & smoother
- Instant "open X" commands: apps open locally with no AI round-trip, and the AI picks up the rest of the task.
- `type_text` can submit in the same step (type and search in one action).
- Network connections are kept alive and pre-warmed when a run starts. The long installed-apps list is only sent when it's needed.
- The cursor buddy now glides on the GPU inside one full-screen layer (no window moves per frame). Mascot drawing reuses its gradients, and the frame rate is capped to save battery.

### Also new
- Favorites (☆ Save) and recent tasks appear as one-tap chips.
- Voice commands from the overlay mic go through Chron as well.

> Uninstall older debug builds first if Android refuses to update. Chron needs the Microphone permission, plus Notifications on Android 13+.
